name: GPU-Accelerated FVR Implementation
definition: A high-performance implementation of the FVR pipeline mapped to run entirely on CUDA-enabled GPUs, achieving a speed-up of 117x compared to a single-threaded hybrid CPU/GPU implementation.
summary: This method maps the entire Fourier Volume Rendering pipeline to CUDA GPUs, achieving 117x speed-up over hybrid approaches while reducing artifacts via zero-padding and high-order interpolation.
